### ripple-current-margin

<EvidenceAnchor id="cov-cya1265-ripple-current-margin" />

- **Coverage ID:** `cov-cya1265-ripple-current-margin`
- **Status:** COVERED

**Reason:** Computed peak-to-peak ripple current for all three board-b rails (VIN=15V, VOUT=13.5V/7.5V/-13.5V, f=150kHz) stays well under both rated limits: +13.5V rail 0.09A (1.06% Isat / 2.00% Idc), +7.5V rail 0.25A (2.94% Isat / 5.56% Idc), -13.5V inverting rail 0.474A (5.57% Isat / 10.53% Idc, the largest of the three due to the higher duty ratio of the inverting topology). All three stay far below the 8.5A Isat and 4.5A Idc ratings.

**Facts in this domain:**

- [`fact-cya1265-ripple-7v5`](#fact-cya1265-ripple-7v5)
